description: This file defines the BackwardCompatilityDirector class within the Orleans.Runtime.Versions.Compatibility namespace. It provides a method to check version compatibility based on version numbers.

classes.name: BackwardCompatilityDirector
classes.description: Implements ICompatibilityDirector to determine if a requested version is compatible with the current version.

methods.name: IsCompatible
methods.description: Compares requested and current versions and returns true if requested version is less than or equal to current version.
